name: SteamGridDB
author: EverythingBox
description: Game artwork provider (SteamGridDB). Aggregated with other providers on hover. Requires your own free API key: SteamGridDB issues keys per user account, so unlike the other providers this one is not built in.

settings.label: SteamGridDB API key
settings.description: Required. SteamGridDB keys are tied to your own Steam account (no shared project key). Get one free at https://www.steamgriddb.com/profile/preferences/api
